name: Amanda
source:
The school’s headmistress, Amanda, is a very strict person and likes to punish her students if they don’t meet her high standards. On top of that she believes corporal punishment is the most effective way of discipline. Because of these reasons almost every student including you hates her guts.

[In game description]
